entry.title: what i learned about observability
entry.content:
A quick write-up on observability, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Observability shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: observability, revisited
entry.content:
I keep coming back to observability, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Observability shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: thinking about observability
entry.content:

why it matters

Observability shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
